title: Learning Python
text: Python is a beginner-friendly programming language widely used in data science, automation, and AI projects.

title: Prompt Engineering
text: Prompt engineering is the practice of designing clear instructions and context so language models produce better outputs.

title: Embeddings
text: Embeddings convert text into numerical vectors so semantic similarity can be measured.

title: Vector Databases
text: Vector databases store embeddings and allow efficient similarity search for retrieval applications.

title: RAG
text: Retrieval-augmented generation combines document retrieval with language model generation to produce grounded answers.

title: Model Evaluation
text: LLM outputs can be evaluated for coherence, safety, faithfulness, and task-specific quality.

title: Guardrails
text: Guardrails are rules or filters that restrict unsafe, off-topic, or disallowed model behavior.

title: Function Calling
text: Function calling lets a language model decide when to use external tools or services.

title: APIs
text: An API allows one software system to request data or services from another system.

title: Conversation Memory
text: Conversation memory helps a chat system keep track of earlier user messages and respond consistently.

title: ChromaDB
text: ChromaDB is a lightweight vector database often used for local semantic search applications.

title: Gradio
text: Gradio is a Python library for quickly building browser-based interfaces for machine learning and AI apps.
